creative_ideas.idea: PRE-ARM BREAKEVEN LOCK — extend the (PASSing) ARM-BE-STOP mechanism DOWN from the 0.40% arm to a 0.25% peak lock for trades that have not yet armed
creative_ideas.rationale: Fresh units-correct giveback ledger (pnl_usdt = amount_usdt x move%/100, UNLEVERAGED, no fees, ceiling-labelled): 14d 399T peaked +$27.85 and finished -$2.62 = $30.47 never harvested. The never-armed class owns it: 183T never-armed, of which MFE<0.30 = 132T '-13.42' at 3.8% WR (86% of the bleed) and MFE>=0.30 = 51T. Locking those 51 at breakeven converts their '-2.13' to the winners-only sum '+0.56' = +$2.69/14d CEILING; at 0.25 the cohort is 64T and the ceiling is +$3.91/14d (+$0.28/day). Because losers end below entry they must cross the lock level, so the CEILING is tight for the loser subset — the only unknown is fk (trades that dip to entry then rally and would have armed). Current ARM-BE (lock after 0.40 arm) already measured fk 9.7% net +$3.46 / 30d candle OOS = PASS, so the mechanism is validated; 0.25-0.30 extends it into a cohort ARM-BE structurally cannot see.
creative_ideas.expected_impact: ceiling +$2.69/14d (0.30) to +$3.91/14d (0.25); realistic after fk unknown
